_doc: Platform profiles. type_mul scales the voice's base type size. min_body is the smallest body size in px for the profile. space_mul scales the spacing scale and control padding. control_height and min_target are in px (dp, pt). focus_ring is the focus outline width in px. motion_mul scales durations and travel. contrast_floor is the lowest contrast level allowed. ground_hint is the default ground when the user does not choose one. Numbers are sensible starting points. Always check the target platform's own human-interface guide for the final values.

mobile.label: Phone and tablet app (iOS, Android)
mobile.safe_area: Respect the notch, status bar, home indicator and system gesture edges. Keep primary actions in thumb reach, in the lower half.
notes: Targets are at least 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android, with 8px between neighbours.
Support dynamic type: text must grow to 200% without clipping.
Use platform back and gesture conventions. Do not invent navigation.
Sheets and bottom bars beat dropdowns and hover menus.
Test in bright sunlight: raise contrast for text over images.

desktop.label: Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux)
desktop.safe_area: Windows resize. Design for a minimum width, then let panes grow. Respect the title bar and the OS menu bar.
notes: Every action has a keyboard path and a visible focus state.
Hover, right-click and drag are available, but never the only way.
Density can be higher than on touch: 32 to 36px controls are normal.
Show shortcuts next to commands.
Follow the OS for window controls, file dialogs and notifications.

web.label: Responsive website or web app
web.safe_area: Design mobile first at 360px, then widen at 480, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1536. Respect env(safe-area-inset-*) on notched phones.
notes: WCAG 2.2 sets a 24px minimum target. Use 44px for touch.
Type and space should be fluid (clamp), not stepped.
Support zoom to 400% and text spacing changes.
Support prefers-color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion and forced colors.
Keep line length at 60 to 75 characters.

tv.label: TV and 10-foot screens (tvOS, Android TV, web on TV)
tv.safe_area: Keep text and actions inside the safe area: about 5% inset (on a 1920x1080 canvas, roughly 80px at the sides and 60px top and bottom).
notes: Everything is reached by focus. The focused item must be obvious from the couch: a ring of 4px or more, plus a scale-up of about 1.08.
Body text is at least 28px at 1080p. Avoid thin weights.
Use a dark ground. Avoid large pure-white areas and fully saturated red, which bloom on some panels.
No hover and no tiny targets. Keep focus order simple and predictable, and remember the last position.
Fewer choices per screen. Long lists need paging or rows with clear rails.
Video and art lead; chrome stays quiet.

car.label: Car display (Android Auto, CarPlay, in-car OS)
car.input: touch, rotary or steering-wheel keys, voice
car.safe_area: Follow the OEM or host template. Keep controls away from screen edges that are hard to reach or hidden by the bezel.
notes: Design for glances: each glance should take about 2 seconds, and a whole task should finish within about 12 seconds of looking away from the road.
Targets are at least 76px (Android Auto and Android Automotive use 76dp). Keep spacing generous.
Short labels, large type, and no long lists or free text. Offer voice for anything that needs typing.
Switch day and night themes by ambient light or headlights, not by hand. Keep contrast high in both.
Keep motion minimal: no looping animation, no parallax, no auto-advancing content.
Use the host's templates and components where they exist. They are certified.
